We design onboarding, core workflows and dashboards that get users to value fast and keep them paying. Book a call See our work What holds SaaS products back Users never reach the aha moment Trials stall before anyone sees value. Weak activation flows mean you pay to acquire users who churn before they understand what the product does for them. Power features bury the core As you ship more, the interface fills with settings, tabs and edge cases. The everyday workflow gets harder, and new users bounce off the complexity. Design cannot keep pace with the roadmap Engineering ships faster than design can support. Inconsistent patterns and one-off screens pile up into UX debt that slows every future release. How do global employment calculators help EOR and recruitment companies accelerate their sales cycles? EOR and recruitment companies often face long, complex sales processes because clients demand detailed, country-specific statutory cost breakdowns before signing contracts. The 1EOR Suite replaces manual calculations with highly visual, embeddable calculators. Your sales teams can generate precise employer cost quotes in under 30 seconds, reducing pricing friction, converting web traffic into hot leads, and accelerating client onboarding. What specific calculators and tools are included in the 1EOR Suite? Our product suite includes 8 specialized global HR and sales-enablement tools: Global Employer Cost Calculator : Computes statutory employer taxes, benefits, social insurance, and mandatory pension contributions for 175+ countries and territories. Global Salary Benchmark : Provides wage profiles (min, median, max) for 2,300+ job profiles across 175+ countries based on ILOSTAT and local databases. Compliance Risk Diagnostic : A 12-question audit assessing contractor misclassification risk across 175+ countries. Contractor True-Cost Calculator : Compiles misclassification liabilities, transfer fees, and payment rails into a single cost card. GCC vs EOR Decision Engine : Formulates the financial threshold for setting up a local corporate entity vs. employing via EOR. Global Mobility Cost Stack : Outlines visa relocation pathways, sponsorship costs, and processing times across 175+ countries. Regulatory Alerts Dashboard : Monitors World Bank, OECD, and local tax changes to protect EOR operators from rate drift. Cost to Employer + Employee : Full payroll ledger with employer cost, employee tax, social security, and net pay across 175+ countries. How do the calculators ensure compliance and statutory accuracy across 175+ countries? The 1EOR Suite utilizes an automated data-ingestion pipeline connected to institutional API nodes, including the OECD Tax Database, the World Bank Open Data library, and regional tax authorities. Our Regulatory Alerts Dashboard scans for changes in tax brackets, pension caps, and social security ceilings, keeping the calculators updated. Additionally, all calculators feature a robust offline baseline fallback to ensure calculations never fail during client presentations. Can we white-label the calculators to match our recruitment or HR brand? Yes. All components are built for complete white-labeling. EOR and staffing firms can customize corporate branding, fonts (supporting Google Fonts like Inter), CSS styling, and logos. These can be configured directly via secure iframe query parameters, integrated via our WordPress shortcode plugin, or fully customized under your own domain using our REST API endpoints. How does the security gateway protect our proprietary data and prevent API abuse? Traditional widgets expose database endpoints and licensing keys in client-side HTML, making them vulnerable to scraping. The 1EOR Suite routes all client queries through our server-side PHP Gateway proxy. The gateway applies domain locks (CORS verification) to block unauthorized hostnames, prevents automated scraping through rate limiting, and hides private database tokens. No personal worker data is ever processed, ensuring complete GDPR and UK-GDPR alignment. How do recruiters use the Contractor True-Cost and Compliance Risk tools to close clients? Recruiters use these tools during consultations to educate clients who are hesitant to hire full-time or are employing contractors illegally. By running the Compliance Risk Diagnostic and Contractor True-Cost calculators, recruiters can visually demonstrate the hidden expenses of contractor management and the massive financial liabilities of misclassification. Big gains come with big effort and big effort takes a persistent long term dedication and focus.  Aesop's fable taught us that it takes humility and perseverance to win the big races, and that's where we come in. Tortoise and Hare Software is a digital marketing agency founded on principles learned from the fable of The Tortoise and The Hare.  We know it's slow and steady that wins the race and we bring a mentality of getting one percent better every day to our clients. Tortoise and Hare Software knows that great outputs starts with taking the time to listen, understand pain points, discover needs, and deliver a solution that eliminates stress and gives you the tools to grow. Core Values Prosperity Prosperity is one of our core values here at Tortoise and Hare. We believe that every American can achieve the state of health, wealth, and happiness that they desire through the development of internal accountability, a dedication to self improvement, and sharing of their success to improve the lives of others in their sphere of influence. Knowledge One of the foundations of prosperity is a commitment to lifelong learning and the quest for knowledge. Knowledge leads to wisdom, a sense of peace, and confidence that can’t be obtained through other means. Knowledge is also one of the key pillars of delivering excellence in business, but it enriches lives on a personal level as well. Apprenticeship Humanity has an amazing and unique ability to pass down knowledge obtained from many lifetimes of experience that came before us. The amount of study handed down from the generations before us in your average prescription pill that enriches so many of our lives is often taken for granted. We want to continue the tradition of enriching the lives of those that come after us through the process of apprenticeship. In many ways we all have a duty to learn from the sacrifices and wisdom of our ancestors by studying previous and current masters of a craft. Craftsmanship Digital marketing and software development aren't all that different from carpentry or other physical incarnation of craftsmanship. Although it’s harder to understand and appreciate from an outsiders perspective than a beautiful house, true craftsmen (and craftswomen!) derive a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment from a job well done rather than external validation. We here at Tortoise and Hare take pride in our work and derive satisfaction from delivering outstanding end results. Causes We Support We spend our day to day lives helping people while running the business of Tortoise and Hare Software, so we balance out our people contributions with environmental conversation efforts and the combating of climate change through our philanthropy.  We love to support our cousins in the sea with our annual Sea Turtle nest adoption campaign. Article Refining the backlog and the Definition of Ready In Scrum, everything revolves around the sprint, a clearly-defined, intensely productive period of time in which the team tackles priorities from the product backlog. But how does the Scrum team (including the product owner) know when those priorities are ready to be addressed? How do you know when it’s time to sprint? This is where the process of backlog refinement, filtered through what’s known as the Definition of Ready (DoR), plays an essential role. Clearly, the Definition of Ready and the refinement process are interdependent. Refinement results in product backlog items that are ready for development, and the Definition of Ready is the criteria by which we can say that refinement has been successful – if a Definition of Ready is at all unclear, you need to revisit the refinement process! ## The MikMak Platform

Built upon a proprietary AI-powered operating system, the MikMak Platform fuels both human and agent-driven omnichannel growth for the world’s leading brands, in real time.

[Video 2](https://www.mikmak.com/hubfs/Aura%20Orb_v2.mp4)

#### Enable Commerce Everywhere

![Image 78: MikMak Commerce](https://www.mikmak.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Commerce%20-%20Platform%20-%20May%202026.png?width=1080&height=566&name=Commerce%20-%20Platform%20-%20May%202026.png)

#### MikMak Commerce

Direct media and website traffic to the most profitable sale with a seamless path to checkout at any in-stock retailer from any of your paid and organic marketing channels, including social media, brand websites, search, CTV, display, and QR codes. Beyond simple "where to buy" enablement, MikMak Commerce is equipped with intelligent, AI-driven configuration technology designed for rapid deployment and limitless scale.

[Learn More](https://www.mikmak.com/mikmak-commerce)

#### Plan and Optimize Future Outcomes

![Image 79: MikMak Aura](https://www.mikmak.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Aura%20-%20Platform%20-%20May%202026.png?width=1080&height=566&name=Aura%20-%20Platform%20-%20May%202026.png)

#### MikMak Aura

A unified, always-on system that instantly connects full-funnel media spend to incremental retailer sales performance. MikMak Aura provides real-time intelligence, fueled by powerful AI, to replace slow forecasts, enabling smarter business decisions and more profitable growth, instantly.

[Learn More](https://www.mikmak.com/mikmak-aura)

#### Measure the Omnichannel Outcome

![Image 80: MikMak Insights](https://www.mikmak.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Insights%20-%20Platform%20-%20May%202026.png?width=1080&height=566&name=Insights%20-%20Platform%20-%20May%202026.png)

#### MikMak Insights

Gain a complete understanding of your shopper across every channel, from AI platforms and media to brand websites and offline store locations. Evaluate cross-channel performance to drive incremental sales, unlock new opportunities for growth, and ensure your national media and retail media work in harmony to maximize profitability. Tap into deep shopper preference data to eliminate silos, optimize campaign performance, and confidently expand your entire commerce marketing strategy where it matters most.

[Learn More](https://www.mikmak.com/mikmak-insights)

[Schedule a Demo](https://www.mikmak.com/schedule-a-demo)

![Image 81: Real-Time Optimizations and Execution_2](https://6547620.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/6547620/Real-Time%20Optimizations%20and%20Execution_2.png)[Video 3](https://www.mikmak.com/)

### Drive Profitability and Market Share

##### Drive Predictive Growth

Predict which channels and retailers will drive growth for better planning and more impactful joint business negotiations, using AI-enhanced predictive modeling to forecast future sales performance.

##### Optimize Product Discovery

Optimize brand websites and media for humans and AI agents, ensuring your products are easily found and purchased, no matter who or what is doing the shopping.

##### Outperform the Competition

Know, compare, and optimize your performance against brands in your category by channel, retailer, and more.

![Image 82: Prove-Incremental Sales](https://6547620.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/6547620/Prove-Incremental%20Sales.png)[Video 4](https://www.mikmak.com/)

### Maximize ROI and Data Security

##### Prove Incremental Sales

Measure true incrementality across every dollar spent, from national brand awareness campaigns to retail media networks, to ensure your investments complement rather than compete with each other.

##### Secure and Action Data

Activate one trusted, all-in-one source of data that connects insights across your team and AI tools for real-time decision making, all backed by built-in security and privacy.

##### Automate Resource Savings

One easy-to-use global platform automatically enables consistent reporting and fast decision-making across the entire organization, reducing manual work and streamlining global operations.

## E-commerce: Frequently asked questions

**How does Daktela help with common e-shop queries like order status, returns, or delivery updates?**

Daktela connects to your e-commerce system and uses AI to automate routine questions (order tracking, returns, delivery details). Agents step in only for edge cases, while customers get instant answers 24/7 across chat, email, and messaging.

**Which channels can we use – webchat, social media, WhatsApp?**

All key channels are available in one workspace: voice, email, webchat, social, and WhatsApp Business. Conversations and history stay linked to the customer profile, so agents always see full context.

**Can we integrate Daktela with our e-shop platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc.)?**

Yes. Daktela is an open platform with pre-built connectors and no-code options. WooCommerce is supported out of the box and Shopify can be linked via workflow tools or API. Orders, customers, and tickets stay in sync for faster resolutions.

**How does Daktela handle seasonal peaks like Black Friday or Christmas?**

AI offloads repetitive traffic and intelligent routing spreads workload across teams. Real-time dashboards and wallboards help you watch SLAs and adjust staffing on the fly, while agents can work from anywhere using desktop and mobile apps.

**What reporting do we get for e-commerce support?**

Out-of-the-box reports and live statistics cover volume, SLAs, channel mix, agent performance, and customer outcomes. You can export data or build custom views for operations and management.

**How long does implementation take?**

Typical pilots go live quickly with core channels and basic automations. We then iterate on workflows, AI intents, and integrations. You can start with a 14-day trial and scale features as you grow.

**Is Daktela secure and compliant for EU merchants?**

Daktela supports secure SSO options (e.g., OAuth 2.0, Entra ID) and adheres to GDPR principles. Data processing is governed by DPAs and documented controls; AI features are designed with GDPR in mind.

**What’s the pricing and how do we start?**

Choose a plan that fits your channel mix and automation needs. Start with a free 14-day trial or request a demo; our team will help size licenses and integrations for your store.

#### REVENUE

## E-Commerce

Give guests an easy way to discover and buy tickets, experiences, F&B, merchandise or upgrades from their phone,  
 whether they’re planning ahead or deciding what they want next while already inside the venue.

[Book a Demo](http://vantage.co/request-a-demo/ "Request A Demo")

### MORE WAYS TO SPEND

## Create More Opportunities to Add to the Day

**For guests:** Easily discover, purchase and add to their experience without having to visit a service desk.

**For operators:** Capture more revenue, promote add-ons and make it easier for guests to spend without adding more work for frontline teams.

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IEVTe0JE6dg)

![Image 4](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/4-1.png)

### Connected Commerce

## Keep the Opportunity to Purchase Open

Respond to Demand in Real Time

Keep what guests see aligned with what’s actually available. Update inventory, availability and offerings as demand changes throughout the day, helping your team promote what you have capacity for and capture more revenue from available experiences and products.

Make Your Offers More Relevant

Use what you know about each guest to surface more relevant products, upgrades and experiences. Personalized recommendations create natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell while helping guests discover additions that make sense for their visit.

Increase Convenience to Increase Spend

Give guests an easy way to browse and purchase tickets, upgrades, experiences, F&B and merchandise directly from their phone. They can add to their day whenever the opportunity arises, without finding a service desk, joining another line or interrupting what they’re already doing.

### How It Works

## Sell Beyond the Initial Booking

### Guests Browse

Guests explore upgrades, F&B, and other add-ons directly from their phones, reducing reliance on frontline teams to manage upgrades and additional purchases.

### Up-to-Date Inventory

What guests see can reflect availability, inventory and where they are in their visit, keeping purchase options relevant to the moment.

### Personalize the Experience

Surface relevant products and add-ons based on guest information and activity, creating more natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell.

### Guest Purchases

Guests can buy or upgrade directly from their device without visiting a service desk or interrupting their day.

### One Guest Profile

Transactions become part of the connected guest profile, giving operators a clearer picture of how each guest spends and engages.

### Adjust Store

Use purchasing and guest behaviour to understand what’s working, adjust offerings and create more relevant opportunities throughout the rest of the visit.

### Explore FEATURES
